description: Defines a template class 'slotted_vector' for managing containers with optional elements, providing O(1) access, insertion, removal, and iteration that skips absent elements. Also defines 'slotted_id_vector' for ID-based indexing.

classes.name: slotted_vector
classes.description: A container managing optional elements with index-based access, supporting O(1) insert, remove, and iteration skipping absent elements.

classes.name: slotted_id_vector
classes.description: A slotted_vector indexed via an ID type, allowing insertion, removal, and access via ID.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an element with given index exists.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Inserts or overwrites element at index with constructor arguments.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts element if not already present at index.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes element by index or iterator.

methods.name: find_first_empty
methods.description: Finds first empty position starting from a guess.

methods.name: unsorted
methods.description: Returns span of all stored objects.
